description: The line plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different approaches: a 3-Model Ensemble (blue), a 2-Model Ensemble (red), and GPT-4 (yellow), as evaluated in the PromptMind Team’s EHRSQL-2024 work on improving SQL generation reliability using ensemble LLMs. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” ranges from 0 to 10 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” spans from 30 to 90, also linearly scaled, with major gridlines every 20 units. The blue line for the 3-Model Ensemble begins near 85 at cost 0 and declines gradually to approximately 73 at cost 10. The red line for the 2-Model Ensemble starts slightly higher at about 86, then decreases more steeply than the blue line, ending near 72 at cost 10. The yellow line for GPT-4 begins at 90 when cost is 0, drops sharply to around 67 at cost 5, and continues declining to approximately 42 at cost 10, showing the steepest degradation in reliability with increasing cost among the three methods.
